row.claim_shape: Conditional on the non-numerical lemmas of the OpenAI subset-sum preprint and of Base's written proof: uniform randomized word-RAM algorithm, halts on every execution, correct with probability >= 2/3, O(2^(T' n)) word operations per input for every fixed T' > T = 0.4875754036 and b <= n^c

verdict_scope: The numerics are independently verified: (1) exact-as-instructed reproduction of all 33 certified margins with python-flint arb (all_pass true, T_ball 0.4875754036, matches paper SS8 value for value); (2) perturbation arms show the checker detects corrupted parameters (rc[0]+1e-3, tau0-1e-6, tau0-1e-5, gamma+1e-5 all fail) with a benign control (tau0+1e-9 passes) and a verified-genuinely-feasible near-miss (tau0-1e-7); (3) a from-scratch stdlib-decimal recomputation of all 33 margins at prec 60 agrees to 18 significant digits, log2M1/log2M2 inside the certified arb balls; (4) the in-repo mpmath-iv implementation stores the same 20 digits; (5) doubled resolution N_in=512 unchanged at 20 digits. Conditions: the claim remains conditional on the OpenAI + Base non-numerical lemmas (not re-derived here, same dependency structure as the 0.487676 and 0.4876723 rows); no Lean proof; not peer reviewed - all consistent with the row's Claimed level.
